name: AdCP 3.2 Content-Digest carries sha-256 and sha-512, both correct — distinct algorithm keys are legal (content-digest covered)
spec_reference: #verifier-checklist-requests steps 1 and 11 (RFC 9530 §2: Content-Digest is a Dictionary keyed by lowercase algorithm name; RFC 8941 §3.1.2); AdCP 3.2 profile per #content-digest-and-proxy-compatibility and #adcp-rfc-9421-profile binary value encoding
$comment: 3.2-profile counterpart of positive/014-content-digest-two-algorithms.json. AdCP 3.2 profile: the signature covers content-digest, binary values use RFC 8941 sf-binary (standard padded Base64), and the verifier advertises covers_content_digest='required'. False-positive guard for negative/023 and 030. Both members are the correct digest of the body in standard padded Base64, and the Signature is a real Ed25519 signature over expected_signature_base, which carries the Content-Digest value verbatim. Generated by scripts/generate-request-signing-profile-3.2-vectors.mjs from the test keys in keys.json; do not hand-edit.
